download_rpa_reranker_model: download the RPA re-ranker model to a specified data path using the download function
run_rpa_reranker_download: run the download function to fetch the RPA re-ranker model v1.0 into the datapath directory
review_download_function: review the download function that delegates to download_with_model_type for the RPA re-ranker model
summarize_rpa_reranker_module: summarize the RPA re-ranker module which provides a download function for fetching the model
test_download_function: test the download function by calling it with a datapath argument to verify model retrieval
